data: Which modalities are represented in the graph?

The graph represents two modalities: Video and Text. This is indicated by the lines and their corresponding labels in the legend. The Video modality is further divided into two sub-modalities: Video R@1 and Video R@5, while the Text modality is also divided into two sub-modalities: Text R@1 and Text R@5. These sub-modalities are represented by different colored lines within the graph.
